decisions.reason: After two years without website presence, this close-to-core handle line likely fell below internal and peer aspiration levels or was superseded, so resources are better reallocated to stronger ranges and new development.
As a single design variant with no visible continuation through 2021, it would be pruned once uncertainty resolved unfavorably relative to aspirations and alternative uses of capacity.
Like other narrowly differentiated design introductions, prolonged non-observation signals underperformance or replacement, making withdrawal the boundedly rational choice.

Although initially supported by the firm’s broad portfolio strategy, two years without market visibility suggest this family no longer justifies shelf, sales, and development resources against aspiration levels.

Despite its strategic fit with digital building organization, the lack of website evidence through 2021 indicates the flagship system likely failed to meet revised aspirations or was replaced by newer solutions, so it should be discontinued.
